attribute.name: adc_threshold
attribute.description: ADC threshold for WIBEth fragment filtering. Fragment kept if any channel/sample ADC >= this value. Set 0 for pass-through (keep all). WIBEth ADC is 14-bit (max 16383); set >= 16384 to reject all WIBEth fragments.

attribute.name: enable_df_influx
attribute.description: If true, dfcontrol.sh launches df_to_influx.py alongside this app to forward its accept/reject ADC histograms to InfluxDB. Connection details (URL/org/bucket/token) are df_to_influx.py's own concern, not DataFilter's.

attribute.name: df_influx_poll_interval_s
attribute.description: Seconds between DataFilter's own histogram-file writes / df_to_influx.py's polls.

attribute.name: enable_frame_filter
attribute.description: Filtering granularity. false (default): keep or drop whole WIBEth fragments, and the ADC histogram gets one entry per fragment. true: rebuild each fragment from only the frames whose max ADC >= adc_threshold, and the histogram gets one entry per frame (much richer statistics, and output fragments shrink).

attribute.name: prefetch_window
attribute.description: How many next_tr/next_ts requests DataFilterReceiver pre-issues to FilterOrchestrator, refilled one-for-one as each TR/TS is ingested. Bounds how far TRDispatcher can run ahead of DataFilter.

attribute.name: processing_mode
attribute.description: immediate, batch_fixed, batch_adaptive, drain_all

attribute.name: buffer_capacity
attribute.description: Max buffer size, 0=unlimited

attribute.name: prefetch_count
attribute.description: Number of TRs to prefetch

attribute.name: batch_size
attribute.description: Batch size for batch processing modes

attribute.name: processing_threads
attribute.description: Number of processing threads

attribute.name: min_free_bytes
attribute.description: Minimum free space required before writing an output file, in bytes.

attribute.name: storage_pathname
attribute.description: This is the path where are the hdf5 files stored.

attribute.name: is_from_storage
attribute.description: Force dispatching real HDF5 files found in storage_pathname. This flag takes precedence: when true, generate_trigger_record and generate_time_slice are ignored (an override is logged) and no synthetic data is produced. Set it false to allow the generate_* flags to select a generated mode.

attribute.name: input_h5_filename
attribute.description: Not used for storage dispatch. TRDispatcher discovers files by scanning storage_pathname, using json_file to skip those already delivered; this attribute only appears in the startup log.

attribute.name: json_file
attribute.description: Store a list of hdf5 files that already delivered to the Data Filter.

attribute.name: generate_trigger_record
attribute.description: Generate a trigger record for testing only. This should be false by default.

attribute.name: generate_time_slice
attribute.description: Generate a TimeSlice for testing only. This should be false by default.

attribute.name: parallel_send
attribute.description: Send TR and TS in parallel threads vs sequentially.

attribute.name: number_generated_events
attribute.description: Max number of generated events. 0 = unlimited.

attribute.name: generated_window
attribute.description: Generated-mode only: max number of dispatched-but-unconfirmed cycles per record type (TR, TS gated independently) before TRDispatcher blocks further dispatch of that type. Ignored in storage mode.
